caption: The drawing features a single object, a cylindrical cup or container, centrally positioned within a rectangular frame on a plain, light-colored background. The cup is rendered in shades of gray, indicating it is likely drawn with graphite or pencil, and the shading suggests a metallic or reflective surface. The cup has straight sides that slightly taper outward towards the top and a rounded lip at the rim. There is a faint horizontal line near the base, indicating a slight ridge or decorative band around the bottom. In the lower left corner of the main rectangular frame, there is a smaller, inset rectangle containing a simplified line drawing of the same cup, presented as a front elevation view and accompanied by a scale at the bottom. The entire drawing is on a piece of paper with a slightly yellowed or aged appearance.
